payload.description: One agreed figure for how each year ended. The council reports its outturn twice and the two do not match. For 2025/26 the provisional report to Cabinet on 10 June 2026 gives a General Fund underspend of £543,000 and a General Fund capital underspend of £22.255m; the draft accounts published the same month give £710,000 and a combined General Fund and Housing Revenue Account capital underspend of £38.291m. The accounts are the final basis and are what this page uses. Nothing published explains the gap between the two.
